summary: דַּמֶּשֶׂק names the city of Damascus. Genesis locates Hobah in relation to it, and Isaiah calls it the head of Aram.

senses.definition: The city of Damascus, the capital of Aram.

evidence.note: מִשְּׂמֹאל לְדַמָּשֶׂק locates Hobah north of Damascus.
Isaiah calls Damascus the head of Aram and Rezin the head of Damascus.
